name: rtm-mcp
description: Remember The Milk MCP server with HTTP and stdio transports

USER_TOKEN.description: Bearer token required for HTTP MCP requests

CALENDAR_TIME_ZONE.description: IANA timezone matching the RTM account

CALENDARIFIC_API_KEY.description: Replace this placeholder with a Calendarific API key, then enable CALENDARIFIC_ENABLED

CALENDARIFIC_ENABLED.description: Keep false until a real Calendarific API key is configured; also disables a retired provider
